summary: Repeated request thrice, AI stuck asking same clarifying question
detailed_context: Dominic said 'wisdom now' three times in the conversation. The AI asked 'What's one?' as clarification, then repeated that same question verbatim when the user restated their request. Instead of adapting or trying a different approach, the AI is back asking the identical clarifying question. This pattern of the AI not understanding the user's intent and repeating itself signals clear dissatisfaction—the user is frustrated at having to repeat themselves and the lack of comprehension/progress. The terse, unchanged responses indicate mounting frustration.
